tenderSchedule.title: AMC for Computers and Printers
tenderSchedule.description: Comprehensive AMC for computers and printers with Supply & Maintenance of Antivirus as per attached NIT document
tenderSchedule.locationName: HGML Sr Manager Met Section Hutti

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
The firm must be registered in India with appropriate tax and other administrative authorities.

As per the Government Orders vide FD/165/EXP-12/2017 dated: 21/03/2017 and FD/539/EXP-12/2017 dated: 02/06/2017, the option of uploading documents in financial bid section is disabled. a. Only landed price shall be mentioned in e-portal which shall be inclusive of all taxes, duties, P&F, freight, other charges, etc. This dashboard price only be considered for price comparison. b. If the bidder quotes in e-portal as exclusive of taxes and become L1, then the purchase order will be made on L1 bidder considering his dashboard price as inclusive of all taxes, etc. If the bidder fails to execute the order, EMD will be forfeited.
As the Government of India has implemented Goods and Service Tax (GST) from 1st July 2017, Hence Bidders are required to quote accordingly in lieu of Taxes, Duties etc.
Bidder shall give undertaking that they have accepted our terms regarding Delivery/Completion, Validity & Payment as per format enclosed.
The document submitted by bidder in kpp portal shall not be in corrupted/damaged/protected format.
The payment and validity period in technical bid B & D should be same.
Bidders shall upload all the Documents in PDF format only.
Other terms and conditions are as per NIT clause and any pre-counter terms and conditions will not be accepted.
If price bid is submitted in technical bid, then EMD will be FORFEITED and your offer will be REJECTED.
All other terms and conditions as per the NIT.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Service Provider shall be in the field on similar business for a minimum period of recent last three years (2022-2023,2023-2024,2024-2025).

The Service Provider shall have executed successfully a minimum of two such AMCs per year at major customers like Industries/institutions with more than 100 PCs clear detail shall be given of such AMCs along with tender documents.
The Service Provider shall submit performance certificate of previous works from any reputed institution like GOVT/ PSU/ MNC/Esteemed Organization etc.
The Service Provider shall have a minimum established set up of 10 trained regular employees to carry out work and details of qualifications and experience of each person shall be given.
The Service Provider shall have experience in maintaining Antivirus server at major customers like Industries/institutions with more than 100 PCs. The details experience shall be enclosed.
The Service Provider shall have experience in proving technical support for printers and scanners, copy of same to be enclosed.

The bidder should have in the three years period, achieved in at least two financial years the turnover per annum not less than the Rs.19 lakhs (2022-2023,2023-2024,2024-2025), certified by Chartered Accountant. Relevant documents to be enclosed.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate or Profit & Loss statement and Balance sheet issued by the chartered Accountant for the year FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Copies of ITR for the last three years i.e. FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Copies of Purchase Order/Completion Certificate/Satisfactory report as a proof for past experience
Duly filled technical bid B should be attached in Technical Bid and format can be downloaded from enclosure
Undertaking as per Technical D should be attached and document can be downloaded from enclosures.
